The residence

Three rooms with the ownership package of a larger home

The apartment is in a nine-floor boutique building on Eliyahu Berlin Street, at the western edge of Tzukei Aviv.1,2 Beyond its three rooms it comes with two private parking spaces, a storage room and a safe room inside the unit, at an asking price of NIS 4,650,000.2,3

The broker gives about 90 sqm built plus a 12 sqm sun balcony facing an open green view. The layout includes a master suite and a bright living space, and the unit is described as particularly quiet. The broker's Madlan listing records 95 sqm with a 10 sqm balcony, and her Yad2 listings give floor 2 or 3 of 9, so the exact area and floor should be checked against the land registry extract and the unit plan.1,2

The building has a designed lobby and a residents' gym, and the management fee is NIS 600 a month.1,5 The apartment is ready to move in and, according to the broker, about five minutes on foot from Tel Baruch beach and the coastal park promenade.

The location

Tzukei Aviv, between the coastal park and the Sde Dov district

Tzukei Aviv runs from Unitzman Street in the north to Propes Street in the south, between Namir Road and the sea.12 Gimel HaHadasha is the name for its newer part, built beside the Azorei Chen towers.11,13 Madlan data published by Mako put the median deal in Azorei Chen from early 2023 to October 2025 at NIS 5.9 million, the fifth highest neighborhood median in Israel.14

The coastal park promenade opened in September 2023 and runs about 2 km along the cliff, from Tel Baruch beach in the south to Tzuk beach in the north, with a bike path along its length.6 Nathan Alterman High School, whose building won the Rokach architecture prize in 2015, is in the neighborhood.15

To the south the Sde Dov district is taking shape, where new apartments sold at an average of NIS 79,000 to 85,000 per sqm according to Calcalist in February 2026.16 The Green Line light rail is expected to open its southern section in 2028 and the full line in 2030.17

Planning

What is planned nearby

Published plans and works, and what they may mean for a buyer or tenant. Based on published reports; not a substitute for a check with the planning authority.

  • Plan TA/3700, the north-west quarter24,25

    About 1,900 dunams between the existing neighborhoods and the sea, up to the city boundary: 11,000 to 13,000 homes, 1,500 hotel rooms and about 215,000 sqm of employment and retail. In August 2024 the reallocation tables were still unapproved, so timing is uncertain.

  • Building heights in plan 370025

    A planner quoted by Globes described 6 to 8 homes per dunam in buildings of eight floors at most, plus a 400-dunam ecological coastal park. The heights set west of the building will shape the open view from lower floors.

  • The Sde Dov district13,16

    About 16,000 homes and towers of up to 45 floors in the center plan; most apartments are expected to be occupied in 2029 to 2032. New supply at higher price levels and years of construction south of the neighborhood.

  • Eliyahu Berlin 3 project11,27

    Madlan shows active construction of 13 floors and 41 units with completion in early 2028, while project-tlv lists it as completed. If active, expect works on the same street until 2028.

  • Hotel and residential tower at Tzuk beach29,30

    A 2021 plan for a 14-floor tower with 116 apartments and a hotel of about 200 rooms; the design plan was approved in May 2025. More activity and traffic at the north end of the promenade.

  • Nofei Yam North31

    In March 2025 the permit freeze was extended for re-planning, with heights that could rise from 15 to 45 floors. Taller buildings are possible south of the neighborhood.

Before you decide

What to check before an offer

The questions a careful buyer asks about this apartment, and the documents to obtain before signing.

  • Which floor is the unit on (2 or 3), and what are the registered net area, gross area and balcony size?
  • What is the exact address, gush and helka, and is the unit registered in the land registry or still with the developer or a house company?
  • Who are the developer and contractor, when were Tofes 4 and the completion certificate issued, and how much of the statutory inspection and warranty periods remains?
  • Which plan 3700 compound lies west of the building, what heights and building lines apply there, and is any tender, permit or construction scheduled?
  • What does the NIS 600 management fee cover (lobby, gym, cleaning, elevators, insurance), and is there a reserve fund?
  • What is the arnona zone and building code, and is the NIS 1,680 figure a two-month bill?
  • Are the two parking spaces and the storage room registered to the unit, and are the spaces side by side or tandem?
  • Who lived in the unit, is it vacant now, and when can it be delivered?
  • Are there open defect claims against the developer or any planned special levies in the building?
  • A land registry extract or a housing company rights confirmation, including the attachment of both parking spaces and the storage room
  • The occupancy certificate (Tofes 4), completion certificate, building permit and unit plan
  • The management company budget and what the fee covers
  • Confirmations of no arrears on arnona, water and management fees

Questions and answers

Questions worth asking

How does the price per sqm compare with the neighborhood?
On 90 sqm built the asking price is about NIS 51,667 per sqm. The Tzukei Aviv median was about NIS 49,000 per sqm in August 2026,13 and 3-room sales on nearby streets in 2025 and 2026 were recorded at NIS 48,734 to 52,632 per sqm, in older buildings.18
Does the apartment have a sea view?
The broker describes a balcony facing an open green view and presents the building as the first building to the sea. The land between the neighborhood and the sea is covered by plan TA/3700, which a planner quoted by Globes described as buildings of eight floors at most.25 Check what is planned west of the building before paying for a view.
How much purchase tax would a buyer pay?
Under the 2026 brackets: about NIS 128,038 for a single-home buyer, NIS 372,000 for an additional home or a foreign resident, and about NIS 13,356 for an eligible new immigrant.33,36 This is not tax advice.
What are the monthly costs?
A management fee of NIS 600 a month according to the broker. Arnona was not published; at 2026 rates for a new building it would be about NIS 771 to 960 a month, depending on the arnona zone.38
When can a buyer move in?
The apartment is ready, and the listings show a flexible entry date.1,2
